scripts.build:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production vite build && npm run build:types
scripts.build:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development vite build && npm run build:types
scripts.verify:release: npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:docs && npm run test:examples
scripts.bench: npm run bench:dom && npm run bench:ssr
scripts.bench:tier1: npm run bench:tier1:dom && npm run bench:tier1:ssr
scripts.bench:tier1:dom: cross-env NODE_ENV=production vitest bench -c vitest.bench.dom.config.ts benches/tier1/ --run
scripts.bench:tier1:ssr: cross-env NODE_ENV=production vitest bench -c vitest.bench.ssr.config.ts benches/tier1/ --run
scripts.bench:tier2: npm run bench:tier2:dom && npm run bench:tier2:ssr
scripts.bench:tier2:dom: cross-env NODE_ENV=production vitest bench -c vitest.bench.dom.config.ts benches/tier2/ --run
scripts.bench:tier2:ssr: cross-env NODE_ENV=production vitest bench -c vitest.bench.ssr.config.ts benches/tier2/ --run
scripts.bench:tier3: cross-env NODE_ENV=production vitest bench -c vitest.bench.dom.config.ts benches/tier3/ --run
scripts.bench:tier4: cross-env NODE_ENV=production vitest bench -c vitest.bench.dom.config.ts benches/tier4/ --run
scripts.bench:json: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); fs.rmSync('bench-results',{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.mkdirSync('bench-results',{recursive:true});" && cross-env NODE_ENV=production vitest bench -c vitest.bench.dom.config.ts --run --outputJson bench-results/dom.json && cross-env NODE_ENV=production vitest bench -c vitest.bench.ssr.config.ts --run --outputJson bench-results/ssr.json
